title: Project creation and invites screen with the structure editor
summary: The Project tab now lists recent projects and pending invitations and creates or connects a project with a PRD structure editor, invites, role, domains and the idea saved as S1, which starts the first grilling agent; a refused invite no longer blocks creation.

deferred.what: The connect flow asks for a typed owner/repository instead of the prototype's searchable repository list, because the store has no method that lists the member's repositories
deferred.why: Needs a new store method outside this story's scope

deferred.what: The in-memory store only answers for repositories that are already projects, so under GRILLO_STORE=memory Check access on example-org/team-code shows Access not known and saving after accepting the seeded invitation fails with not found, breaking the demo and QA path
deferred.why: Fix is in the memory store, outside the screen folder

deferred.what: The creation run lives only in the mounted screen; if agents:start refuses and the member leaves the screen, the project exists with S1 saved but nothing in the interface starts /grillo-wayfinder for it again
deferred.why: Needs a start-the-grilling-agent entry point outside this screen's in-memory run, a design call beyond this story
